# U83: Looking after a metric: as Rhea, adding “CI cost per pipeline run” asks about CI compute cost per pipeline run and still saves; its To sort out lists what is missing and Say what it means opens the form at that field; changing a unit goals use asks first; a metric goals use offers Retire, not Delete, and deleting one no goal used says so and Undo puts it back. As Tunde the page has none of these and says who can change it. As Amara, marking its owner as left passes the metric to his team’s new lead to confirm, and About counts no metric with no owner

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRICS-CARE`
- **Budget:** at most 20 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/metrics/new` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U83

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/metrics/new` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “CI cost per pipeline run” into the “Name” field.
- **Step.** Type “USD” into the “Unit” field.
- _Note:_ A close name is a Check (MT1): asked once the name is left, answered once, then it saves.
- **Check:** “This looks like “CI compute cost per pipeline run”” is shown in the part `[data-check="name"]` (else: a close name is not asked about).
- **Check:** (`entry`) there are 1 of the “Use that one” button in the part `[data-check="name"]` (else: the close-name question has no Use that one).
- **Step.** Press the “Lower is better” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Mine is different: keep it” button in the part `[data-check="name"]`.
- **Check:** “You said: mine is different.” is shown in the check said (`.check-said`) (else: an answered Check does not close to one line).
- **Step.** Press the “Add the metric” button.
- **Check:** The “CI cost per pipeline run” heading shows.
- _Note:_ What it still needs, each with the button that opens the form at that field.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/No meaning yet/.test(needs) && /No source named/.test(needs)`, where `const sort = p.locator('.metric-need-list')`; `const needs = (await sort.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: To sort out says “{needs}”.
- **Step.** Press the “Say what it means” link in the metric need list (`.metric-need-list`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/edit?field=meaning”.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await p.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement?.closest('#metric-meaning'))`. Else it says: Say what it means does not open the form at the meaning.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “to sort out”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Changing the unit of a metric goals use is asked first; keeping it changes nothing.
- Go to `/metrics/queue-wait/edit` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “s” into the “Unit” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** “1 goal is measured by Pipeline queue wait (p90) in min. Is “s” a new label for the same numbers, or a different scale” is shown in a dialog (else: changing a unit goals use is not asked first).
- **Step.** Press the “Keep it as it was” button in a dialog.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `(await p.getByLabel('Unit', { exact: true }).inputValue()) === 'min'`. Else it says: Keep it as it was did not put the unit back.
- _Note:_ A metric goals use is retired, not deleted (MT3); one no goal has used is deleted, and Undo brings it back.
- Go to `/metrics/queue-wait` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Retire this metric…” button shows.
- Go to `/metrics/{worked out in the journey as `encodeURIComponent(String(added?.id ?? '').replace(/^metric_/, ''))`}` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Delete this metric…” button.
- **Check:** “No goal has been measured by it.” is shown in the “Delete “CI cost per pipeline run”” dialog (else: Delete does not say no goal used it).
- **Step.** Press the “Delete the metric” button in the “Delete “CI cost per pipeline run”” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the button in the message that pops up showing “Undo”.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `usedDelete === 0 && !!met && !met.removedAt`, where `const usedDelete = await p.getByRole('button', { name: /^Delete this metric/ }).count()`; `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const added = (s0.modules?.metrics?.metrics ?? []).find((m) => m.name === 'CI cost per pipeline run')`; `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const met = (s1.modules?.metrics?.metrics ?? []).find((m) => m.id === added?.id)`. Else it says: {worked out in the journey as `usedDelete ? 'a metric goals use offers Delete' : 'Undo did not put the metric back'`}.
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ Someone else: none of these, and who can change it.
- Open a fresh browser as Tunde (`tunde`).
- Go to `/metrics/queue-wait` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Pipeline queue wait (p90)” heading shows.
- **Check:** “Rhea Kapoor or an admin can change this.” is shown (else: the page does not say who can change it).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `offered === 0`, where `const offered = (await t.locator('.metric-need-list').count()) + (await t.getByRole('button', { name: /^(Retire|Delete) this metric/ }).count()) + (await t.getByRole('link', { name: 'Change this metric' }).count())`. Else it says: Tunde was offered {offered} ways to change a metric he doesn’t own.
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ An admin marks the owner as left: his metric passes to his lead to confirm (MQ2), so About counts no metric with no owner.
- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/people` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “Mateo” into the field showing “Find by name, job title or team”.
- **Step.** Press the “Mateo Fernández” link.
- **Step.** Press the “Mark as left…” button.
- Find and pick: press “Who takes over Mateo’s N goals” in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog, type “marisol”, and choose “Marisol Duarte”.
- **Check:** “passes to Marisol Duarte, to confirm.” is shown in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog (else: the sheet does not say his metric passes to the lead).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark as left” button in the “Mark Mateo Fernández as left” dialog.
- **Check:** “Mateo Fernández is marked as left” is shown.
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `mttr?.ownerId === 'marisol' && mttr?.handover?.from === 'mateo'`, where `const sa = await h.snapshot()`; `const mttr = (sa.modules?.metrics?.metrics ?? []).find((m) => m.id === 'metric_mttr')`. Else it says: his metric is owned by {mttr?.ownerId}, handover {JSON.stringify(mttr?.handover ?? null)}.
- Go to `/workspace` in the demo.
- **Check:** A heading shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) the words “metrics ha(s / ve) no owner” is not there (else: About counts a metric with no owner after its owner’s metrics passed to the lead).
- Close this browser.
